description: This Java class 'AuditSection' is a part of the salesmanager core model package. It represents an embeddable entity used to track audit information such as creation and modification dates along with the user who modified the entity. It provides getter and setter methods for these fields, utilizing a utility class 'CloneUtils' to clone date objects for encapsulation.

classes.name: AuditSection
classes.description: An embeddable Java class representing audit information such as creation date, modification date, and modified by user, used as part of entity auditing.
